_about: Belt windows lane, by eye on ruler-gridded zooms of each picked crop (full-resolution px, y down from the crop's top): per storey row the window columns x [x0, x1] and the frame's top and bottom y (outer edge of the frame, sill board included), the panes, head, frame and sash paint. Merged into opening-measures.json by scripts/belt-review/measure-openings.ts --eye.
